summary: 3M NORGE AS (org. no. 914 307 635) is a private limited company (AS) based in Lillestrøm, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-02-19. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.900 (Uspesifisert engroshandel); it has 28 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 871.3 m and net income was NOK 27.3 m. Board chair: Lars Petter Plaaterud; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
